paragraphs: He spoke in Rabbi Shimon Chasida’s name in [Bava Kamma 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.113b.7).[^1]

notes.text: Hyman’s Hebrew spells the name שמון. The linked Bavli has Rav Bivi bar Giddel speaking in the name of Rabbi Shimon Chasida (שמעון חסידא). See also [Heilprin’s entry on the same chain](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3485&lang=en).
